videos.title: Inside Theranos with ex-Employee Tyler Shultz
videos.description:
With Theranos and Elizabeth Holmes back in the conversation, we’re revisiting one of the most remarkable firsthand accounts of what actually happened inside the company.

Tyler Shultz joined Theranos fresh out of Stanford as a true believer in its mission. His grandfather, former Secretary of State George Shultz, sat on the company’s board, and Elizabeth Holmes had become a mentor and even a presence at family gatherings. But once Tyler began working directly with Theranos’s technology, he discovered that the reality inside the lab looked very different from what the company was telling the world.

On The Social Radars, Tyler sat down with Jessica Livingston and Carolynn Levy to tell the full story of how he went from employee to whistleblower: the failed blood tests and red flags he uncovered, the culture of fear that kept employees silent, his attempts to raise concerns internally and with regulators, and the extraordinary legal pressure he faced after speaking to The Wall Street Journal.

This episode was originally recorded on December 4, 2024.

What if your AI agents had their own 3D office, just like real employees? 

Imagine having an entire AI team working inside a virtual office where you can monitor tasks, track agent activities, and visualize workflows in real time!

In this video, I'll show you how to build a 3D AI Agent Office using Grok Bot, turning traditional AI agent monitoring into an interactive 3D experience.

Instead of checking boring logs or traditional 2D dashboards, you can explore a 3D workspace that represents what your AI agents are doing.

What Is a 3D AI Agent Office?

A 3D AI Agent Office is an interactive virtual environment designed to visualize the activities of AI agents.

Imagine having different AI agents responsible for different tasks:

Coding Agent -- Helps develop applications, debug code, and implement features.

Research Agent – Collects information, analyzes data, and prepares research summaries.

Analytics Agent – Processes data, monitors metrics, and generates reports.

Automation Agent – Executes supported workflows and coordinates repetitive tasks.

Coordinator Agent – Helps organize tasks and coordinate activities across multiple agents.

Instead of managing everything through text based interfaces, a 3D dashboard can represent these agents as virtual employees working inside an office.

You can visualize their task status, workflow progress, and activity updates in one place.

Why Is Everyone Talking About 3D AI Agents?

AI agents are becoming increasingly capable of handling complex workflows.

Developers are now experimenting with new ways to visualize and manage these systems.

Traditional AI dashboards display information using charts, tables, logs, and status indicators.

A 3D AI office takes a different approach by representing agent activities inside an interactive virtual environment.

This makes it possible to explore concepts such as:

• Virtual AI employees

• Interactive AI agent monitoring

• Real-time task visualization

• Multi-agent collaboration

• AI workflow dashboards

• Agent activity tracking

• Virtual workspaces for autonomous systems

The 3D interface is a visualization layer. Actual agent execution, automation, and continuous operation depend on the underlying tools, integrations, and infrastructure.

Real World Applications

A 3D AI Agent Office could be useful for:

1. AI Development Teams

Visualize coding agents, testing agents, and research agents working on different development tasks.

2. Business Automation

Monitor AI workflows responsible for customer support, reporting, research, and operational activities.

3. Multi Agent Systems

Explore how multiple specialized agents coordinate tasks within a shared workflow.

4. AI Monitoring Dashboards

Create an interactive interface to observe agent status, progress, and execution results.

5. AI Learning and Demonstrations

Make complex agentic AI concepts easier to understand through visual representations.

Build Your Own 3D AI Office

In this tutorial, we'll explore the process of creating a 3D virtual office, representing AI agents inside it, and connecting the visualization to agent activity.

We'll also discuss how Grok Bot can assist with the development workflow and how you can adapt the concept to your own AI projects.

Whether you're using AI agents for coding, research, automation, or business operations, this project demonstrates a creative approach to visualizing your AI-powered workspace.

Known as "GaryVee," he is described as one of the most forward thinkers in business. He acutely recognizes trends and patterns early to help others understand how shifts in consumer attention impact the realities of the business world today. Gary's approach sits at the intersection of business and pop culture. He keenly understands how to bring brand relevance to the forefront. He is a prolific angel investor with early investments in companies like Facebook, Twitter, Tumblr, Venmo, Snapchat, Coinbase, and Uber.

Gary is an entrepreneur at heart – he builds businesses. Today, he helps Fortune 1000 brands leverage consumer attention through his full-service advertising agency, VaynerMedia, which has offices in New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Miami, Toronto, Mexico City, London, Amsterdam, Sydney, Singapore, Tokyo, Bangkok, Delhi, and Kuala Lumpur. VaynerMedia is part of the VaynerX holding company, which also includes Gallery Media Group, The Sasha Group, VaynerSpeakers, and Tingley Lane Trading. Gary is the Co-Founder of VaynerSports, VCR Group, VaynerWatt, ArtOfficial, Resy, and Empathy Wines. He guided Resy and Empathy to successful exits -- which he later sold to American Express and Constellation Brands, respectively. He also owns a Major League Pickleball team called the 5s, is part owner of a Big3 basketball team, and is an investor in the revival of the SlamBall League.

In 2021, Gary created VeeFriends, an entertainment company that has become a rising powerhouse in modern entertainment and collectibles. Often described as Pokemon meets Sesame Street, the company leverages stories, games, events, collectibles, and technology to scale its character universe. Vaynerchuk also has negotiated partnerships with brand powerhouses such as Crocs, Fanatics, Macy’s/Toys “R” Us, Mattel’s UNO, Mattel’s Masters of the Universe, Moonbug Entertainment, Reebok, Squishmallows, Topps, and more.

He is a six-time New York Times bestselling author, with titles including Crush It!, Jab, Jab, Jab, Right Hook, Twelve and a Half and Day Trading Attention. In addition to running multiple businesses, Gary documents his daily life as a CEO through his social media channels, which have more than 45 million followers and garner more than 300 million monthly impressions/views across all platforms. His podcast, "The GaryVee Audio Experience," ranks among the top podcasts globally.

Gary serves on the board of MikMak, Bojangles Restaurants, Global Citizen Forum, The Paley Center, and Pencils of Promise. He is also a longtime Well Member of charity: water.
